content:
The **Charcoal Axolotl** is an amphibian in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A rare amphibian that can be caught with Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 10 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Charcoal Axolotl (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (25) | 

Can only be caught during the month of January, at any fishing spots in the Savage Divide and Burning Springs.

Prior to the release of the Burning Springs update, this Axolotl could be found in Skyline Valley.
